http.title: HTTP layer — Arrest framework
http.body: Exposes the Flow Engine REST APIs externally. Each endpoint handles a phase of the conversational lifecycle: handle-new-contact initializes a new conversation, change-task transitions the FSM state, prompt returns the system prompt for the LLM, memory manages context variables, close-contact closes the contact in multi-contact scenarios.

flowservice.title: FlowService
flowservice.body: Concrete implementation of FlowServiceAbstract for development and testing environments. Loads flows from MongoDB via FlowDomainObject, manages tracking of active conversations and provides debug utilities like getRunner() and cleanupConversation(). In production it is replaced by an implementation that loads flows from the tenant database.

abstract.title: FlowServiceAbstract
abstract.body: Abstract base class that defines the entire conversational orchestration workflow using the Template Method Pattern. Implements initializeConversationAndGetData() (6 Redis operations, 50% optimized), changeTaskAndGetData() (7 ops, -36%), resumeConversationAndGetData() (10 ops, -29%). Only loadFlow() is abstract — everything else is shared between implementations.

runner.title: FlowRunner
runner.body: Manages the FSM lifecycle for a single conversation. FSMCompiler translates the Flow JSON into an XState v5 machine: task names are sanitized (spaces → underscores, accents removed) and become XState events directly. Each HTTP request loads the snapshot from Redis, sends the event, saves the new snapshot.

memory.title: MemoryManager
memory.body: Implements 3-hash variable storage with deterministic priority resolution: vars:tools (maximum priority, written by external MCP tools) → vars:convMiner (values extracted by AI) → vars:definitions (defaults from flow configuration). Version-based Conditional Fetch avoids 2 out of 3 Redis calls when memory hasn't changed.

mongo.title: MongoDB
mongo.body: Persistence of conversational flows via AssetContainer and FlowDomainObject. At startup 8 fixture flows are loaded into configured environments: simpleFlow, complexFlow, medicalBooking, multiContact, flowCupSolidale and variants, simpleFlowWithCheckpoints, flowWithCustomAudioConfig. Flows persist between service restarts.

redis.title: FlowRedisService + Redis
redis.body: FlowRedisService is a Singleton wrapper that guarantees a single Redis connection for the entire application. Redis hosts three categories of data: serialized XState snapshots for FSM persistence between stateless requests, the 3 hashes of conversational memory (definitions, convMiner, tools) with TTL for automatic expiration, and the list of previous contacts for multi-contact flows.
